# jobrunner

Small job runner with a pluggable, bounded exponential retry policy.

## Retry policy

`run_job` preserves its public signature and accepts a `RetryConfig`, a
pluggable `Sleeper`, and a job closure. The `max_attempts` setting includes
the initial call. Only `RetryError::Transient` failures are retried;
`RetryError::Permanent` failures are returned immediately.

Retries wait for `base_delay_ms`, then double the delay for each subsequent
retry. The delay is capped at `max_delay_ms`, including when a very large
attempt count would otherwise overflow the exponential calculation.
